hints.title: Periodic Pattern String Symmetry
hints.text: If string s consists of a repeating block of length k, then the longest proper prefix matching a suffix will cover all but one period of the string.

hints.title: LPS Divisibility Condition Invariant
hints.text: A string of length n has a repeated substring pattern if and only if lps[n - 1] > 0 and n is evenly divisible by n - lps[n - 1].

hints.title: Prefix Function Validation Procedure
hints.text: Calculate the prefix array lps for string s. Examine the final value lps[n - 1]. If it is strictly positive and the remaining length n - lps[n - 1] divides n with zero remainder, the string is periodic with repeat unit size n - lps[n - 1].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input length or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all divisor period lengths by slicing and repeating strings costs O(N * sqrt(N)) or O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: KMP prefix table computation determines periodicity in O(N) time with O(N) auxiliary array space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should link the definition of the KMP prefix function to string periodicity and modular arithmetic.
